description: This file defines the UserController class within an ASP.NET Core web application, responsible for user-related functionalities such as retrieving the current user info and handling user logout. It interacts with services like token management, authentication, and caching.

classes.name: UserController
classes.description: ASP.NET Core API controller managing user-related actions, including retrieving current user details and logout process.

methods.name: GetCurrentUser
methods.description: Gets information about the current authenticated user.

methods.name: Logout
methods.description: Handles user logout by signing out from authentication schemes, clearing cache, and logging the event.

methods.name: CreateUserInfo
methods.description: Constructs a UserInfo object with details extracted from ClaimsPrincipal, including claims and token.
